package.description: ARR 3 improves web app scalability via rule-based routing, load balancing, client/host affinity, and disk caching. It optimizes server farm resources, supports health monitoring, and integrates with IIS Manager for easier management.

en-US.description: ARR 3 improves web app scalability via rule-based routing, load balancing, client/host affinity, and disk caching. It optimizes server farm resources, supports health monitoring, and integrates with IIS Manager for easier management.
en-US.longDescription: IIS Application Request Routing (ARR) 3 enables Web server administrators, hosting providers, and Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) to increase Web application scalability and reliability through rule-based routing, client and host name affinity, load balancing of HTTP server requests, and distributed disk caching. With ARR, administrators can optimize resource utilization for application servers to reduce management costs for Web server farms and shared hosting environments.
en-US.name: Microsoft Application Request Routing 3.0
